summary.zh-CN: Microsoft 官方 Playwright MCP 服务，提供浏览器截图、DOM 快照、表单操作等工具。注意：playwright 子依赖的 postinstall 会下载浏览器二进制，--ignore-scripts 会阻断此步骤，需要在受管安装后额外执行浏览器安装命令。中国大陆 Playwright CDN 访问受限。
summary.en: Microsoft's official Playwright MCP service providing browser screenshots, DOM snapshots, form operations, and more. Note: playwright's postinstall downloads browser binaries; --ignore-scripts blocks this step, requiring a separate browser install step after managed installation. Playwright CDN may be restricted from mainland China.

description.zh-CN: 获取当前页面无障碍树快照
description.en: Get accessibility tree snapshot of the current page
Take a screenshot of the current page

conditions.zh-CN: playwright 子依赖 postinstall 下载浏览器二进制被 --ignore-scripts 阻断，需受管安装后额外步骤
conditions.en: playwright sub-dependency postinstall for browser binaries is blocked by --ignore-scripts; requires an extra step after managed install

conditions.zh-CN: 中国大陆 Playwright CDN 访问受限，需使用镜像或离线安装
conditions.en: Playwright CDN may be restricted from mainland China; mirror or offline install required
